page: Microsoft Azure F8-2amds_v7 is a virtual machine offering that pairs high clock-speed AMD hardware with an unusually dense memory footprint. Powered by an AMD EPYC 9V45 x86_64 processor clocked at up to 4.5 GHz, the instance provisions 2 dedicated physical cores mapping to 2 vCPUs with 1 thread per core. The compute hardware is backed by 48 KB of L1 data cache, 1 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of L3 cache, with native support for AVX-512 vector operations and SHA-NI cryptographic acceleration. A key structural feature is the integration of 64 GB of RAM alongside 945 GB of high-speed local NVMe SSD storage, providing 32 GB of memory per core without bundled GPU accelerators.

Benchmark data demonstrates top-tier single-core performance, driven by the 4.5 GHz clock frequency and modern architecture. In synthetic benchmarks, single-threaded metrics achieve leading percentiles, including a stress-ng single-core score of 3521.69, a Geekbench single-core score of 2714.0, and high throughput in single-threaded gzip compression and bzip3 decompression. The processor also achieves upper-tier metrics in Geekbench text processing at 3246.0. Conversely, the strict two-core hardware ceiling naturally bounds multi-threaded scaling. Multi-core Geekbench and stress-ng results register in the mid-tier, while highly parallel operations such as Clang software compilation and ray tracing score in the lower percentiles.

From a workload and efficiency standpoint, the F8-2amds_v7 delivers an economical profile for applications bounded by memory capacity rather than core counts. With 32 GB of RAM per vCPU, environments that would otherwise require paying for high core counts to secure 64 GB of memory can operate within this two-core boundary. Coupled with 945 GB of local NVMe storage and average memory read throughput of 52.38 GB/sec for uncached blocks, the system fits in-memory caching systems such as Redis, memory-intensive ETL preprocessing, and relational databases with low concurrency requirements.
description: Microsoft Azure F8-2amds_v7 is a specialized virtual machine configuration combining a high memory-to-core allocation with dedicated compute resources. Driven by an AMD EPYC 9V45 processor operating at up to 4.5 GHz, the instance supplies 2 dedicated physical cores and 2 vCPUs without simultaneous multithreading, alongside 64 GB of system memory and 945 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. Hardware extensions include AVX-512 and advanced cryptographic instruction sets. Benchmark evaluations place its single-core capability in the top tier, reflected in strong Geekbench single-core, text processing, and single-threaded compression scores. However, with only two processing threads, parallel throughput tasks such as large compilation and multi-threaded decompression exhibit lower relative metrics. The combination of 32 GB of memory per core and rapid local NVMe capacity makes the instance cost-efficient for workloads requiring substantial memory footprints without demanding extensive multi-core parallelism, such as Redis caching layers, memory-resident key-value stores, and light database operations.

tagline: High-frequency dual-core architecture with massive memory density and fast local NVMe storage for memory-bound and single-thread intensive data workloads.
